assertions.subject: Malignant mesothelioma

assertions.subject: Malignant mesothelioma
assertions.quote: most patients die within 1 year of diagnosis

assertions.subject: small cell carcinoma
assertions.quote: The prognosis for small cell carcinoma in any location is poor

assertions.subject: small cell carcinoma
assertions.quote: a 5-year survival rate of less than 15%

assertions.subject: Solitary fibrous tumors
assertions.quote: Solitary fibrous tumors greater than 20 cm with more than 4 mitotic figures per high power field are associated with a poor prognosis

assertions.subject: Solitary fibrous tumors
assertions.quote: these tumors are thought to exist on a risk spectrum dependent on factors including patient age, tumor size, and mitotic numbers

assertions.subject: ovarian cancer
assertions.quote: metastatic omental disease with a worse prognosis secondary to increased chemoresistance and altered tumor biology compared with metastases in other sites

assertions.subject: gastric cancer
assertions.quote: omental metastases from gastric cancer have not been shown to alter overall or disease-free survival significantly
